name: Morning Grace Mobile-First Layout
principles: phone layout is composed independently from desktop
primary task appears before decorative artwork
compact grouped rows replace large desktop cards
48px-class top app bar and 60px-class bottom tab bar
touch targets remain at least 44px where primary interaction requires it
desktop and tablet Morning Grace layouts remain unchanged
Morning Grace visual identity remains intact without oversized editorial hero treatment
phone landscape remains in the mobile app composition
root tabs and pushed detail workflows use different mobile navigation chrome
secondary management and history workflows use dense mobile-native compositions
loading, error, empty, conflict and draft states use native mobile patterns

chrome.topBar: root destinations use a compact sticky title bar with Search and Data; pushed routes use a 44px contextual Back control plus route title
chrome.appearance: moved from phone app bar to Data/Settings
chrome.bottomNavigation: four compact fixed tabs on Today, Bible, Prayer and History only; hidden during pushed/detail workflows
chrome.immersiveTasks: active Focused Prayer removes outer app chrome while empty and finished states retain pushed navigation

screens.today: compact morning header + grouped four-reading list + two small response cards
screens.bible: reading-first; no chapter artwork on phone; compact sticky book/chapter controls; bottom verse actions
screens.prayer: compact header, small primary action, inline session-depth choice, horizontal status tabs, dense request rows
screens.history: compact header and segmented tabs, three-column factual summary, dense calendar
screens.secondary: stacked pushed workspaces with app-bar Back navigation, no duplicate visual H1, no root bottom tabs, and dense task-first mobile composition

secondaryNavigation.behavior: hide root bottom tabs and Search/Data utility actions; expose contextual Back navigation
secondaryNavigation.returnContext: preserve validated explicit return targets and the exact root utility source, including route query state; otherwise use the nearest logical root
secondaryNavigation.safeAreas: app bars, sticky editor actions and immersive prayer account for device insets

utilityNavigation.search: Search opened from a root or contextual entry point carries an explicit return target and preserves it through query/filter changes
utilityNavigation.data: Data opened from a root app bar carries the exact root route and query as its return target
utilityNavigation.directOpenFallback: direct Search and Data routes without a return target fall back to Today

denseSecondary.prayerDetail: single-stream request, lifecycle, timeline and context composition with visible status
denseSecondary.prayerSettings: flat settings page with compact controls and sticky save actions
denseSecondary.prayerMetadata: People/Categories editor precedes a dense saved-item list on phone
denseSecondary.historyDetail: History Day retains date context; Moments/Day use compact timeline rows and a local segmented switcher
denseSecondary.enlargedText: two-column mobile action layouts collapse to one column at 200% text

mobileStates.loading: compact inline/route loading treatment that keeps app chrome visually primary
mobileStates.recovery: compact in-shell recovery and startup states with 44px actions
mobileStates.draftDialog: bottom-sheet confirmation with safe-area padding and stacked 44px+ actions
mobileStates.conflictReview: edge-to-edge comparison block with explicit keep/use actions
mobileStates.empty: quiet inline states without decorative desktop-card spacing
mobileStates.platformStatus: slim offline/update system strip below the app bar
mobileStates.enlargedText: bottom sheet, conflict actions and platform status reflow without horizontal scrolling at 200% text
